grades.quote: When this bit is 1, execution of RDTIME-like instructions at the PLV3 privilege level will trigger an instruction privilege level error exception (IPE).
grades.reason: Names the exception raised when an instruction is disallowed at a privilege level (instruction privilege level error, IPE). It covers only the RDTIME-like case controlled by CSR.MISC, not privileged instructions in general.

grades.quote: All privileged instructions are accessible only at the PLV0 privilege level.
grades.reason: Says privileged instructions are accessible only at PLV0, with an exception for CSRRD reading performance counters. It does not name the exception raised on a violation.
Only defines the four privilege levels and says applications usually run at PLV3. It says nothing about an exception for a disallowed instruction.
Covers address alignment faults (ALE/ADEF), which are unrelated to executing an instruction that the privilege level does not permit.
